title: Live preview
offline: The preview is not running ({{state}}). It shows here as soon as it starts.
noProxy: The server has no preview proxy (COLONY_PREVIEW_ADDR), so it cannot open here.
askAgent: Please start a live preview (preview_start) of the app with a compose.yaml.
startHint: Puts a request to the agent in the composer: the agent starts the preview with its own compose file.
confirmBody: The preview's containers stop. The panel can be closed and reopened later; a stopped preview starts again with Restart.
restartHint: The agent's machine starts {{name}} again with its last compose file.
